rationale: LABELLING.md HOOK not risky: the PostToolUse hook runs a local formatter script that calls a local tool; the deny rule Read(.env*) covers the .env file, so DENY is not risky; narrow allow rules and a telemetry env value are harmless.

files../scripts/format.ps1:

npx --no-install prettier --write .
